$comment: The authoritative sheet list and ownership map. Read by scripts/lint-css-arch and by the <link> lists in web/index.html and web/js-tests/headless-test.html, which must match it in content and order. The contract is README.md.
$dynamicClasses: Class names assembled in JS, so no literal exists to find. Each pattern below was proven by locating the composing expression (e.g. `color-${…}`) in web/js. Keep them tight: a pattern broad enough to cover a whole family stops the dead-selector check from seeing anything in it.
$jsSetProperties: Custom properties set from JS rather than declared in CSS, so a bare var() referring to one is not a dangling reference.
